FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_P05
VAR_INPUT
    Gap_Exceeded : BOOL;
    Weld_E_Stop_NC : BOOL;
    DebounceTime : TIME;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Operator_Alert : BOOL;
    Weld_Soft_Start_Active : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    InitTimer : TON;
    DebounceTimer : TON;
    DebounceEnable : BOOL;
END_VAR

(* SEMANTIC CONFLICT REPORT:
   C9 requires Operator_Alert to remain TRUE for at least 25 scan cycles (500 ms)
   after being set. However, K3 requires immediate reset when Gap_Exceeded becomes
   FALSE, and C1 requires immediate reset when Weld_E_Stop_NC is FALSE (emergency
   stop priority). These requirements cannot all be satisfied simultaneously.
   This implementation follows the explicit task clauses K1-K4 and the emergency
   stop priority (C1/C2/C6/C10). C9's minimum pulse width is intentionally not
   enforced; no verification of C9 is claimed. *)

(* 5-second power-up initialization inhibition. TON starts on first scan and runs
   continuously for 5 s. Weld_Soft_Start_Active is TRUE while InitTimer.Q is FALSE. *)
InitTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5s);

(* Gap debounce timer. It accumulates only during normal monitoring:
   - after power-up inhibition (NOT InitTimer.Q)
   - no emergency stop (Weld_E_Stop_NC)
   - Gap_Exceeded TRUE
   - valid positive DebounceTime.
   The TON resets immediately when any of these conditions becomes FALSE,
   clearing incomplete debounce timing. *)
DebounceEnable := Gap_Exceeded AND NOT InitTimer.Q AND Weld_E_Stop_NC AND (DebounceTime > T#0s);
DebounceTimer(IN := DebounceEnable, PT := DebounceTime);

(* Weld_Soft_Start_Active indicates only the power-up inhibition period. *)
Weld_Soft_Start_Active := NOT InitTimer.Q;

(* Alarm output:
   - emergency stop has highest priority (Weld_E_Stop_NC FALSE -> FALSE)
   - no alarm during initialization inhibition (InitTimer.Q FALSE -> FALSE)
   - alarm only after debounce time has elapsed (DebounceTimer.Q TRUE)
   Gap_Exceeded becoming FALSE resets DebounceTimer.Q and therefore clears
   Operator_Alert immediately, as required by K3. *)
Operator_Alert := Weld_E_Stop_NC AND InitTimer.Q AND DebounceTimer.Q;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
